comment: The DSP is Émilie Gillet's Rings, vendored unchanged at eurorack/rings; src/anuli.cpp is the Rack wrapper, which runs one Rings part per polyphonic channel through its own resampler. Two of the hardware's normallings are marked TODO in the wrapper and are handed to the DSP as flags rather than implemented in Rack: internal_exciter, internal_strum and internal_note are set from each jack's connected state at anuli.cpp:337, so the behaviour comes from the Rings code itself. The frequency control voltage jack normals to one twelfth of a volt at anuli.cpp:334, which is what makes its attenuverter a fine tuning knob. The strum threshold is 1V, which the manual does not give. Every per-channel read uses getVoltage(channel) rather than getPolyVoltage(channel), so the five control voltage jacks, V/OCT, IN and STRUM all drive one channel per cable channel, with no spreading of a monophonic cable across the engines. The default tuning adds 1.501V to the pitch, selected by frequencyOffsets[1] in src/anuli.hpp; the Compatibility options menu selects the 0.0 entry instead.
